Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor

Class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationWaterInventoryProjection

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationWaterInventoryProjection
public final class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationWaterInventoryProjection extends Object
Projects qualified aqueous H2S/O2 segment evidence onto an explicit water inventory.

The projection multiplies the existing molality-basis mean total-sulfide loss rates and reacted molalities by a caller-supplied liquid-water inventory. It does not derive water holdup, assign reaction products, consume oxygen, or mutate a process or thermodynamic system. Product-agnostic sulfur-equivalent mass views use the shared sulfur atomic molar mass from IronSulfideWallInventory; they are elemental bookkeeping, not an elemental-sulfur yield.

    • project

      public static AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationWaterInventoryProjection.TrajectoryResult project(AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationTrajectory.Result trajectoryResult, double waterInventoryKg)
      Project a complete immutable trajectory onto one constant liquid-water inventory.

      The same inventory is applied to every source-ordered segment. This preserves the trajectory's telescoping inventory balance without implying that water holdup has been calculated.

      Parameters:
      trajectoryResult - qualified trajectory result
      waterInventoryKg - constant liquid-water inventory [kg]
      Returns:
      immutable dimensional trajectory evidence

    • timeToRemainingMolesRange

      public static AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationWaterInventoryProjection.RemainingMolesTargetResult timeToRemainingMolesRange(double initialTotalSulfideMolality, double targetRemainingMoles, double waterInventoryKg, List<AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationTrajectory.Segment> segments)
      Locate when an absolute remaining total-sulfide target is reached at constant water inventory.

      The dimensional threshold is converted to a remaining fraction and delegated to the existing piecewise analytical crossing calculation. No product identity, oxygen demand, or process source term is inferred.

      Parameters:
      initialTotalSulfideMolality - initial total-sulfide molality [mol/kg water]
      targetRemainingMoles - requested remaining total sulfide [mol]
      waterInventoryKg - constant liquid-water inventory [kg]
      segments - non-empty ordered exposure segments
      Returns:
      immutable dimensional threshold and piecewise crossing evidence
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when inputs are outside the source or numerical domain, the target exceeds the initial dimensional inventory, or every fit-scatter path cannot reach the target
